quarterly_data.quarter: M31 Technology press release: M31 Expands Rambus Collaboration, Strengthening Its (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Rambus: M31 announced a technology collaboration with Rambus for its MIPI CSI and MIPI DSI controller technologies, combined with M31's silicon-proven MIPI PHY portfolio, so M31 can offer a complete MIPI subsystem (PHY plus CSI/DSI controllers). CEO Scott Chang: customers previously procured controllers separately and relied on M31 for integration; the collaboration lets them entrust the complete MIPI interface design to M31. The company expects the average total contract value of these subsystem engagements to increase compared with its previous PHY-only licensing model, with a strategic focus on automotive, smartphones and AI edge computing.
